heading: Chapter XIV. [1155]
paragraphs: The work is not of promise, [1156] unless a man be found in the power of faith, even to the end. __________________________________________________________________
[1155] Chaps. xi. xii. xiii. of the Greek are totally wanting in the Syriac, and only these few words of chaps. xiv. and xv. are represented.
[1156] The meaning seems to be that mere profession, without continuous practice, is nothing. __________________________________________________________________
